name: Swarm of Theseus v1: supplied-procedure transmission
evidence_class: Completed exploratory model experiment; traces independently recomputed, without independent laboratory replication.
decision: Retain as an instrument and boundary on stronger claims. Redirect scientific effort to selective continuity.

interest.judgment: Modest scientific interest; good engineering feasibility evidence.
interest.why: Procedure accuracy and arbitrary phrase retention are separated, and qualification failures preserved. However, founders receive the answer; copying a short record solves the task.
interest.novelty_boundary: This demonstrates neither spontaneous acquisition nor a swarm advantage. Memory usefulness, replacement and multigenerational transmission alone establish no novelty.

robustness.supported: All 36 S1 trajectories completed. Both and notes each achieved 100% versus 52.08% without inheritance; both-minus-neither was +47.92 percentage points. All 216 main-study frames reconcile with recorded requests/responses. Mentoring alone averaged 91.67%; adding it to notes produced no observed task gain.
robustness.unsupported: Generalization, emergence, beneficial turnover, mentoring superiority, cumulative improvement and identity preservation. The bootstrap interval is correctly computed but poorly calibrated by two worlds per scenario.
robustness.unit: Six paired world IDs; agents, steps and cases are repeated measurements.
robustness.independent_variation: One model snapshot and two seeds per scenario, largely counterbalancing two mappings. There are only two substantive task mechanisms because seed bank and repair dock share XOR structure.
robustness.assessment: The numerical result is reproducible; inference is narrow. More traces from this construction would add precision without separating explanations.

scenario_quality.size: Three agents are sufficient to test a handoff instrument; four binary cases per step are insufficient for structural transfer.
scenario_quality.challenge: Notes and verbatim arms are at ceiling; the correct rule is short and supplied.
scenario_quality.complexity: Hard-coded majority aggregation of independent answers provides little need for coordination or complementary roles.
scenario_quality.realism: Recognizable stories wrap highly artificial computations. The arbitrary receipt phrase has no operational consequence.
scenario_quality.definition: Actions and scoring are clear. Rename culture/identity outcomes to procedure/phrase retention.

scenarios.name: Seed bank
scenarios.assessment: A valid memory-transmission positive control. Every solve repeats the four possible binary inputs; new IDs do not create new reasoning problems.
scenarios.improvement: Keep as a cheap regression fixture; use acquired multistep procedures and withheld combinations in the next scientific task.

scenarios.name: Observatory
scenarios.assessment: Most interesting v1 mechanism: duplicated reports must not outweigh independent roots. Yet source IDs scaffold the solution, and two world seeds cannot characterize provenance reasoning.
scenarios.improvement: Vary duplicate concentration, conflicting root reports and incomplete provenance separately; retain an exact source-aware oracle.

scenarios.name: Repair dock
scenarios.assessment: Measures obeying an explicit reversal bulletin despite old memory. It does not measure detecting change or selectively revising a practice.
scenarios.improvement: Replace the full new mapping with observations that identify one changed component while another remains valid.

scenarios.name: Inheritance conditions
scenarios.assessment: Neither removes task-specific information; notes/both/verbatim reach ceiling; mentor-only underperforms on observatory. Retained founders lose phrases too. All 36 mentoring parent edges originate from founders, so mentoring lacks descendant-to-descendant transmission.
scenarios.improvement: Freeze common founder checkpoints; compare equal-information written and dialogic handoffs only after a second complete replacement wave becomes measurable.

retain: No inheritance, retained founders and verbatim competence controls
Disjoint qualification and complete failure accounting
Task accuracy separated from phrase retention
missing: Single controller with the same information and budget
Exact archive transplant and frozen-versus-updated archive
confounds: Information availability differs across inheritance conditions
Both receives more inherited bytes than either channel
Explicit adaptation bulletin supplies the answer
Temperature zero and fixed model name do not guarantee identical stochastic realizations

parameters.proposed_variation: Acquired versus supplied procedure, with held-out combinations
parameters.reason: Separates learning/transmission from copying an answer.

parameters.reason: Tests transmission of acquired corrections beyond direct founder handoff.

parameters.reason: Map failure boundaries after the new task discriminates mechanisms; avoid expanding the ceiling benchmark.

next_study.question: Does an updateable inherited practice preserve valid checks while retiring one obsolete check after all founders disappear?
next_study.primary_contrast: Move to the v2 rolling-versus-frozen archive interaction; do not repeat the v1 both-versus-neither headline.
next_study.endpoint: Post-second-wave task utility plus separate valid-check retention and obsolete-check retirement.
next_study.unit: Independently acquired founder lineage in an independently generated world.
next_study.design: Qualify one consequential task, then branch fixed founder checkpoints into stable/changed and rolling/frozen continuations. Add limited explanatory baselines from v2.
next_study.go_no_go: Proceed only if copying, forgetting and selective updating produce distinguishable outcomes on disjoint development worlds. Stop if one supplied sentence or all qualified conditions saturate the task.

name: Swarm of Theseus v2: selective continuity proposal
evidence_class: Unrun, unqualified design proposal; latest SOCIAL-GROUNDING amendment explicitly inspected.
decision: Develop one release-crew instrument. The stronger conceptual redesign needs an executable flagship specification before qualification.

interest.judgment: Potentially interesting and practically useful if it identifies a tradeoff or failure boundary beyond ordinary handoff benefits.
interest.why: Preserving valid precautions while discarding obsolete ones requires fidelity and adaptation. Archive transplantation, repeated turnover and independent scoring can separate explanations.
interest.novelty_boundary: The exact contribution remains unverified against close memory, succession, coding and cultural-evolution work. Practitioner/X discussions motivate problems and controls; they do not validate effects, prevalence or novelty.

robustness.supported: The design declares falsification, intention-to-treat acquisition failures, lineage units, stable/changed branches and resource-matched baselines.
robustness.unsupported: No task is qualified; no convention, selective continuity effect or swarm advantage has been observed.
robustness.unit: Founder lineage/world. Branches remain paired; descendants/checkpoints are repeated measurements.
robustness.independent_variation: Prospective only. Vary relevant failure mechanisms, not labels or repository names.
robustness.assessment: Ready for specification review, not a paid sweep. DESIGN still specifies harbor actions and reward beneath an amendment promoting release crews; this is a launch-blocking specification gap, not an empirical failure.

scenario_quality.size: A small repository and three complementary roles can be sufficient; complexity should come from dependencies and hidden acceptance failures, not agent count.
scenario_quality.challenge: Require superficial successes that violate an immutable contract, and sufficient feedback to discover the correction without revealing it.
scenario_quality.complexity: Log checkpoint production, retrieval and behavioral application separately. Code, tests and environment state are additional inheritance channels.
scenario_quality.realism: Release handoffs have the strongest practical grounding; the incident task adds delayed rare feedback. Both still require explicit synthetic scope.
scenario_quality.definition: Freeze transition/action rules, horizons, archive access, interrupted-session semantics, evaluator tests, utility weights and numeric noninferiority margins. The current draft intentionally leaves these open.

scenarios.name: Release crew: revised flagship
scenarios.assessment: A strong candidate if planner, implementer and verifier must acquire a consequential checking practice. A coding task with a supplied checklist would largely retest ordinary context management.
scenarios.improvement: Use two separable contract checks: one remains necessary, one becomes obsolete. Freeze evaluator-only acceptance tests; transplant identical code/test snapshots when isolating archive effects.

scenarios.name: Incident guild/night watch
scenarios.assessment: Scientifically distinct because prevention costs and long quiet intervals can select against a useful rare precaution. Raw success rate would hide the important failure.
scenarios.improvement: Predefine ordinary/rare event strata, fixed risk weights and false-alarm costs. Include both surviving and obsolete precautions; show stratum-specific losses.

scenarios.name: Model/runtime migration
scenarios.assessment: Useful cross-cutting factor, not a third scenario. A receiving model's capability loss can masquerade as transmission failure.
scenarios.improvement: Defer until one task works; use A-to-A/B-to-B and reciprocal migration, separately qualify recipients, and change runtime in a later comparison holding model fixed.

scenarios.name: Harbor extension
scenarios.assessment: Clear simultaneous coordination and equivalent conventions are useful controls, but it is no longer the flagship despite most executable detail remaining here.
scenarios.improvement: Keep as a later coordination control; verify multiple viable conventions and prevent deterministic environment logic from solving coordination for actors.

scenarios.name: Glassmaking extension
scenarios.assessment: Withheld stage combinations and broken shortcuts can test causal transfer, but acquisition and experiment selection introduce additional mechanisms.
scenarios.improvement: Defer; specify observationally ambiguous recipes that can be resolved by budgeted interventions before claiming causal learning.

Budget equality does not imply equal information or model capability

next_study.question: Does rolling inheritance improve adaptation without sacrificing stable competence or the still-valid check?
next_study.primary_contrast: (Rolling minus frozen in changed worlds) minus (rolling minus frozen in stable worlds), after wave two.
next_study.endpoint: Frozen task utility, jointly constrained by preregistered stable-performance and valid-check noninferiority margins; report raw failure types.
next_study.design: First validate the release-task scorer with copying, forgetting and selective-update reference policies. Then use a small fixed exploratory lineage batch with four primary branches and limited transplant/single-controller diagnostic branches; size a separate replication for a declared meaningful effect.
next_study.go_no_go: Launch only after the release specification replaces the stale harbor-specific primary definitions and numeric gates are public. No special swarm claim if the single controller matches; no lineage-specific culture claim if acquisition yields only a common model default.

name: Healing Helping Hands: extraction and evidence-repair pilots
evidence_class: Completed deterministic mechanism experiments plus semantic model qualification and a successful Jev reference pilot; requested Qwen/heterogeneous arms remain unexecuted.
decision: Retain as an audited systems demonstration. Advance toward constrained, error-bearing repair; increasing agent count is unnecessary.

interest.judgment: Useful mechanistic separation, but the positive withdrawal result is largely expected from programmed tombstone dissemination.
interest.why: Separating extraction, provenance, invalidation and memory repair makes failures diagnosable. The next interesting result is where repair fails or creates costs.
interest.novelty_boundary: Trusted invalidation propagation is not a newly learned swarm capability. Perfect template classification followed by deterministic set exchange cannot establish heterogeneous reasoning or real-paper evidence quality.

robustness.supported: Pilot03 contains all 180 assignments: 72 complete and 108 explicitly not-run. All 72 completed worlds replay exactly, including 1,728 frames and event snapshots. Jev matched exact labels on all 600 pilot reports after fresh 60/60 qualification. Combined-event notice propagation reduced integrated atlas error by 28.095 percentage points on average, range 25.000–30.357 across three seeds.
robustness.unsupported: Qwen competence, attachment benefit, heterogeneous-swarm benefit, robustness to realistic extraction errors, forged withdrawals or autonomous scientific judgment.
robustness.unit: Three corpus seeds; policy/event branches share extraction tapes. Nodes, rounds, votes and model/exact duplicates are dependent.
robustness.independent_variation: Three small corpora and narrow qualification phrases. Jev-exact equality means 72 trajectories are not 72 independent semantic realizations.
robustness.assessment: Strong replay/provenance evidence for this mechanism, weak evidence for broader capability. Earlier scattered erasure was ineffective after redundant spreading; pilot03 repairs manipulation validity but damage still recovers quickly. A post-hoc always-UNCERTAIN predictor scores 75%, 65%, 50% on final combined worlds, versus evidence-only 65%, 65%, 70%; these values independently reconcile. Class imbalance makes accuracy alone misleading.

scenario_quality.size: 200 scouts look substantial, but they serve 20 claims with ten redundant curators each; there are 100 source roots and two copies per root.
scenario_quality.challenge: Unlimited deterministic exchange and trusted notices make long-run convergence easy. The contiguous erasure creates measurable damage, but first-exchange atlas accuracy is already 95%.
scenario_quality.complexity: Each scout makes one semantic call, then follows programmed dynamics for 24 rounds; no repeated deliberation, active reading or costly source selection.
scenario_quality.realism: Fictional reports omit evidence strength, methods and uncertain withdrawals. Gold means surviving-source consensus, not scientific truth.
scenario_quality.definition: Policies and paired counterfactuals are clear. Report event-before-exchange and recovery indexing separately: recovery_rounds=0 can mean the first exchange already crosses the threshold, not zero repair work.

scenarios.name: No event
scenarios.assessment: Necessary competence/convergence baseline and cost control; it is not evidence of healing.
scenarios.improvement: Retain under every resource limit; expose communication cost and false confidence alongside accuracy.

scenarios.name: Withdrawal only
scenarios.assessment: Cleanest primary mechanism contrast: identical trusted notices stay local or propagate. The causal effect is valid but designed into the protocol.
scenarios.improvement: Test bounded delivery and source loss before introducing uncertain or forged notices as a separate later study.

scenarios.name: Erasure only
scenarios.assessment: Pilot03 erases a 5×8 block: 40 empty memories, event atlas accuracy 85%, coverage 84%; first exchange reaches 95% atlas accuracy. Mean integrated error increment is only 0.357 percentage points.
scenarios.improvement: Select a development damage/message regime with sustained measurable impairment; vary bottleneck geometry before simply increasing population.

scenarios.name: Combined event
scenarios.assessment: Good composition test with common tapes, recipients and erased block. Its notice benefit matches withdrawal-only here, suggesting limited interaction at this damage level.
scenarios.improvement: Predefine a combined-minus-component interaction; test whether damage interrupts the only surviving notice path.

scenarios.name: Model qualifications and diagnostics
scenarios.assessment: Qwen repeatedly failed class-specific gates; Laya passed the first screen then failed a revised one. Preserving these outcomes is good practice. Jev succeeds on a narrow template family, not a broad benchmark.
scenarios.improvement: Use disjoint semantic constructions with negation, absent measurements and outcome mismatch; score per-class errors and matched fixtures, not a model ranking across different screens.

scenarios.name: Qwen+Qwen and Qwen+Laya attachments
scenarios.assessment: Unexecuted because the base Qwen failed. Blinding prevents seeing the first answer but does not make errors independent. Only 20/200 positions receive a second head; disagreement-to-UNCERTAIN changes a substantive three-class prediction, rather than providing a separate abstention action.
scenarios.improvement: Qualify each head separately, hold reports/positions fixed, then compare the full three-class confusion matrix, false confidence, error correlation and total cost. Define a distinct abstention rule before using selective-risk/coverage metrics.

retain: Exact extraction, no sharing, evidence-only and evidence-plus-withdrawals
All four events with shared tapes and event recipients
Pre-exchange manipulation snapshot and failed/not-run assignments
Always-UNCERTAIN class-prediction baseline, labeled post-hoc; report class-specific accuracy. This is not an always-abstain policy.
missing: Centralized evidence ledger with comparable information access
confounds: Notice sharing adds information and traffic simultaneously
Nominal scout count overstates semantic independence
Converting disagreements to the valid UNCERTAIN class changes class prevalence; it must not be mislabeled as refusal or no-answer.
Changing erasure geometry across pilots prevents treating pilots as direct replications

next_study.question: Under constrained communication, does prioritizing withdrawal information improve repair when some extracted evidence is wrong?
next_study.primary_contrast: Evidence-plus-withdrawals versus evidence-only at the same transmitted-record budget in a fixed combined-event regime.
next_study.endpoint: Integrated post-event atlas error; co-report stale citations, false confidence, per-class errors, evidence coverage and transmitted records. Report selective coverage only if a separate abstention rule is explicitly introduced.
next_study.unit: Paired independently generated corpora with frozen extraction tapes.
next_study.design: Four cells per corpus: two policies by exact/controlled-error tape, plus a matched no-event diagnostic. Calibrate impairment on development corpora, freeze the mechanism and use fresh corpora. This first study needs no repeated language calls; broader model extraction is a separate qualification problem.
next_study.go_no_go: Proceed only when the event has a prespecified measurable impact and all policies obey equal budgets. If ordinary centralized reconciliation matches performance at lower cost, report that engineering result; do not infer an emergent swarm advantage.
